claims: Brad Underwood has been the head men's basketball coach at the University of Illinois since 2017.
Brad Underwood has led the Fighting Illini to three Big Ten titles.
Brad Underwood has led the Fighting Illini to multiple NCAA Tournament appearances.
Brad Underwood led the Fighting Illini to the Elite Eight in 2024.
Brad Underwood is the Richmond Family Endowed Men's Head Basketball Coach.
Brad Underwood has secured over 80 Big Ten wins during his tenure.
Brad Underwood's Big Ten wins rank among the best in school history.
Brad Underwood was the 2021 Big Ten Tournament Champion.
Brad Underwood was the 2024 Big Ten Tournament Champion.
Brad Underwood was the 2022 Big Ten Regular Season Champion.
Orlando Antigua is the associate head coach on Brad Underwood's 2025-26 coaching staff.
Geoff Alexander is on Brad Underwood's 2025-26 coaching staff.
Tyler Underwood is on Brad Underwood's 2025-26 coaching staff.
Camryn Crocker is on Brad Underwood's 2025-26 coaching staff.
Shauna Green is the head coach of the Illinois Fighting Illini women's basketball team.
Shauna Green was hired as head coach of the Illinois Fighting Illini women's basketball team in 2022
